strings: m_c has always struggled to put {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} thoughts into words. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} may have a language disorder.
When m_c complains to r_c about struggling to understand what other cats say for the 5th time in 3 days, r_c gently suggests that m_c may have a language disorder.
m_c is seeing r_c for a routine checkup when r_c notices that m_c has been struggling to understand verbal instructions. r_c diagnoses m_c with a language disorder.
